data.name: Magical Girl Accountant's Revenge
data.detailed_description:
"Magical Girl Accountant's Revenge" is a visual novel game where players engage in interactive tasks to progress the plot.

Ye Wanqing, a young girl, is the illegitimate daughter of the president of Fangfei Group. After the sudden illness and death of the president, the group was seized by the vice president, Xiong Tianba. Under the pressure of her mother, Ye Wanqing, who had learned of her identity, applied for a job as a junior accountant in the group's finance department to investigate the truth and initiate revenge.

The rise and revenge of a young girl

Covering: the mystery of one's origins, the small brick used to knock on the door, twelve subsidiaries, the hidden game of promotion, the disappearing oyster, the betrayal of love and being loved, and the final choice ...

Multiple Choices & Endings

120,000 words across 9 different endings where every choice matters.

Financial Accounting Knowledge Challenge

Over 20 game tasks. Conducted through methods such as clicking, dragging, and inputting, involving themes such as: the art of balance, subject grids, loopholes in balance sheets, and passwords for secret rooms ...

Ye Wanqing

She is the illegitimate daughter and the only daughter of the former president of Fangfei Group.

Xiong Tian

The new president of Fangfei Group, the partner of the former president, and a long-time friend.

Qi zishan

The Chief Financial Officer, who has had ambiguous relationships with multiple female colleagues, is one of Wanqing's suitors.

Amy

The accountant in the finance department is thoughtful and aims to stand out.

Yi Fei

CEO of a live streaming company, a young and talented entrepreneur, and one of Wanqing's admirers.

Tian fei

The team leader of the tax bureau's inspection team is talented and cautious, and is one of Wanqing's admirers.

data.short_description: A visual novel encompassing financial accounting knowledge and interactive tasks: You will play as Ye Wanqing, a young girl who grows from an entry-level accountant to a CFO, and uncovers the truth behind the illegal occupation of her father's company to seek revenge.
